theorems.name: Submission.ts_pdb_piece_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (K : NNReal), MeasurableSet C → LipschitzWith K F → Set.InjOn F C → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) C → ∃ J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ, ContinuousOn J C ∧ (∀ v ∈ C, 0 ≤ J v ∧ ∀ S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (fderiv ℝ F v '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * volume S) ∧ ∀ g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ, Continuous g → ∫ y in F '' C, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ v in C, J v * g (F v)
